quarterly_data.quarter: SUMCO press release: Consolidated Financial Results for Q2 FY2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 outlook (earnings release): the supply-demand situation for 300mm wafers overall is expected to continue improving as customer inventory drawdown proceeds; SUMCO will further enhance its response capability by upgrading its 300mm manufacturing facilities and will reorganize production systems for 200mm and smaller wafers. Risks from the situation in the Middle East have not affected operations at this time, but the company has concerns about the impact on procurement costs, including for electric power and materials.
